cabinet.reason: the Tech's cabinet (§03 Loop, Reroute): the block's one control cabinet, at the office plot's north-west corner, 17.8 m from the public door and 6.5 m behind the entrance camera's pole, outside every cone (the camera's, the door guard's and the patrol's sweep along y -44.8, which ends at x 52, 5.5 m short of it). Was in the square 28 m from the old north door (moved 2026-10-19 with the door, Sky's option (b)). The point stands 1.05 m off its south face (x 45.45), centred on it, on ground the walk grid holds free with 0.5 m to spare, so the engine's 1.5 m device reach and 2 m tether are measured from where the Tech stands, with no snap to the nearest free cell.

patrol-a.src: the top-down test: the patrol sweeps 11 units in front of the public door, from 4 to one side of it to 16 to the other
patrol-a.reason: the sweep's south end: the patrol walks the forecourt's outer edge (y -44.8, 3.55 m out from the public door on the wing's west face and 1 m out from the foot of its steps), from by the entrance camera's pole (patrol-b, x 52, 12 m north of the door axis x 64) to here, 4 m south of the axis and 1.4 m short of the service door (69.4, -41.1); it crosses the Office approach both ways each round. Moved 2026-10-19 with the door (Sky's option (b); Vantage, brief 023), was (40.75, -34) in front of the old north door: the top-down test's sweep in front of the door, shortened to the forecourt between the camera pole and the service door.

patrol-b.reason: the sweep's north end, by the entrance camera's pole (53, -44.5), 12.5 m from the public door. Moved 2026-10-19 with the door (was (40.75, -14)).

patrol-reroute.src: the top-down test: a rerouted patrol waits at the far corner from the door
patrol-reroute.reason: the square's south-east edge by Rocket Lane, on the pavement off the carriageway (was (20, -58), on the road), 45 m up the street from the public door, which faces Rocket Lane: far from the door and the service door, so the entry and the carry-out go unseen by it while it stands here. 10.8 m from the getaway bay on the way the carry comes in, and 1.6 m from guard-ally. Moved 2026-10-19 (Vantage, brief 023; the common fix of briefs/011/vantage/study.ts, then tuned). Seen at the play camera (V-1), so it no longer declares itself hidden.

service-bay.src: GDD §07 route B: the turned driver moves the pickup to the service lane; civic-block.json serviceBay in the Office's east service yard (Sky 2026-10-19, the service door on the east face; Vantage, brief 023); plan frame (-145.0, -293.75)
service-bay.reason: where the turned driver's car stands for the service-lane pickup: in serviceBay, nose in, facing -x (north, back toward the yard's closed end), 2.3 m from 'Service lane' (62.5, -16.8), where Vale comes out by the service door and walks about 2 m to the car. It replaces 'Service lane' as the car's stand; Vale's stop stays 'Service lane'. The car reaches it from Apron Road by the yard's reserved vehicle way (y -16.5..-13.5), which becomes a drive when Splice's world and Keel's engine 0.8.2 let cars cross the pavement there. The facing is a reason, not a field: the mission schema has no heading for a car, so the engine takes it from the bay.

block-spot.src: GDD §07 route B: driver blocks pickup camera 2:30
block-spot.reason: where the turned driver's car stands to block the pickup camera: in the office bay, pulled 2.9 m forward from the pickup (Official drop-off, 78.2, -31) on the bay's first drive row, a drive cell, so engine 0.8.2's car.drive parks it exactly here. Re-sited 2026-10-19 (Waymark, brief 023; Aster: the solid block, blockMoveS 8 s kept). The car (1.81 x 4.73 m, kit Sedan_Official) stands across both of the camera's lines from its pole (74, -40): to the car at the pickup a chord of 4.0 m, and to the kerb side where Vale boards (77.3, -31) 2.4 m, drawn along the bay; 4.8 m and 2.8 m drawn at the heading it drove in on, which the host keeps when it stops. Was (75.7, -36.4) on the pavement, then (77.25, -36.25), where only the car's corner clipped the pickup line and the boarding line missed.
